title: 第5728章 无法相信第5727章 一片沉默
lines: 一个糟糕消息，让西方全体高层集体沉默。
根据西方联合作战情报显示，同一时间在华夏出现许多注销国籍，并且没有注册任何国籍的人。
这些人乍一看都是寻常百姓，但翻开他们的履历可以发现，都曾有过战场经验。
其中获得过华夏各个地区兵王称号的就有六人，其余还有许多在西方、非洲等地闯下过赫赫名声的雇佣兵。
这些人在注销国籍之后，立刻消失在华夏大陆上，但根据可靠情报显示他们的目的地只有一个，如今的战乱海湾。
一股强烈不好的预感，在诸位西方高层的心底荡漾开，起初只是微波，接着变成惊涛骇浪，一时间让所有人的下意识握紧拳头。
根据湾岛附近海域的状况来看，一个华夏曾经的退伍军人，就将一整个吜国编制的航母舰队干翻，永远沉入大海里。
这么多华夏退伍军人同时出发，那他们派出去的航母舰队将会是怎样的下场？
当然，他们可以挑战一下，毕竟不是每一个退伍军人都跟死神一样令人恐惧。
能一个人干翻一整个航母舰队的，放眼全世界怕是也没几个，怎么可能全部出现在华夏？
但经过一番深思熟虑之后，一干西方高层领导达成统一默契，立刻让所有的航母舰队掉头回来。
他们不能挑战，更不能输，否则他们的列强地位将彻底被动摇，同时将华夏推上位。
他们现在不能冒这个险，也不敢冒这个险，一旦命令下达之后失败了，他们就将是国家的千古罪人，谁愿意背负这个骂名？
湾岛附近的海域渐渐恢复平静，没有了轰隆的爆炸声，只剩下还在燃烧的浓烟，飘向广袤天空。
在剧里刚刚战斗发生了几海里外，是一列整齐的华夏航母舰队。
舰队上战士们戎装待发，脸上充满刚毅与决然，身披军装从戎一生，等的就是这个时候。
守卫边疆，报效祖国，哪怕战死在沙场上也无怨无悔。
远方的战斗情报不断传到航母主舰指挥舱内，航母舰队最高指挥官。裴占勇，此刻正与一干舰队高层坐在会议室里。
面对接下来可能发生的100种情况，他们必须要有1000种应对之策，国家边疆领土寸土不让，这一战不光是领土问题，还有国际地位与威慑力等问题。
裴占勇面色冷峻，手中捏着的香烟，燃烧出长长的烟灰，看向现场的一干高层下属，语气透着郑重与威严道：“今天接下来这一场仗，肯定会是一场硬仗，我们华夏方面还从来没在海上，与敌人展开过这么激烈的战争。
如果往前追溯，那就是在上一个封建王朝的时候，当时我们华夏海军败得一塌糊涂，爷在世界上落下了话柄，那一群侵略过我们的老外说，华夏的军人全部都是旱鸭子，他们根本打不了海战。
今天我们要面对的是世界上海军实力最强大的丑啯，里昂航母舰队再丑啯所有航母舰队当中，至少排名前五，这是一个有极其丰富作战经验的海军队伍。
而我们当下的舰队刚成立没几年，这一场战争还没得开打，世界上对我们看衰的声音已经响成一片，尤其那些西方列强，全部等着看我们被打成一堆废铁，沉入海底。
说实话，我个人对于这一次海战，并没有十足信心，要敢于承认自己的不足，才可以在战场上尽量化劣势为优势，我的要求只有一个，待会儿只要战争开打了都给我往死里打，我们哪怕被击沉，被撕碎，但也要让对方付出惨痛代价。
如果这场仗打赢了，那我们将是华夏的千古功臣，我就想问在座的诸位一句……”
“有没有信心！？”裴占勇声音陡然拔高，目光灼热，脸上的表情更是慷慨激昂。
咚咚——
众人刚要满腔热血开口回答，会议室的门被敲响了，裴占勇手下的副官走进来。
content_en:
A piece of bad news that silenced all senior leaders in the West.
According to Western joint operational intelligence, there were many people in China who had canceled their nationality and did not register any nationality at the same time.
At first glance, these people appear to be ordinary people, but looking through their resumes, you can find that they all have battlefield experience.
Among them, six have won the title of King of Soldiers in various regions of China, and there are many others who have achieved great fame in the West, Africa and other places.
After these people canceled their nationality, they immediately disappeared on the Chinese mainland, but according to reliable intelligence, they had only one destination, the current war-torn bay.
A strong bad premonition rippled through the hearts of all Western senior officials. It was just a microwave at first, and then turned into a stormy sea, causing everyone to subconsciously clench their fists.
Judging from the conditions in the waters near the bay island, a former Chinese veteran overturned an entire aircraft carrier fleet organized by the country and sank into the sea forever.
With so many Chinese veterans setting off at the same time, what will be the fate of the aircraft carrier fleet they sent out?
Of course, they can challenge it. After all, not every veteran is as scary as death.
Looking at the whole world, there are probably only a few people who can defeat an entire aircraft carrier fleet by one person. How could they all appear in China?
But after careful consideration, a group of senior Western leaders reached a tacit understanding and immediately ordered all aircraft carrier fleets to turn around and come back.
They cannot challenge, let alone lose, otherwise their status as a great power will be completely shaken and China will be pushed to the top.
They can't take this risk now, and they don't dare to take this risk. Once the order fails, they will be the country's eternal sinners. Who wants to bear this infamy?
The sea area near the bay island gradually returned to calm. There was no longer the roar of explosions, and only the thick smoke that was still burning was left, floating into the vast sky.
A few nautical miles away from the battle that just took place in the play, there was a neat Chinese aircraft carrier fleet.
The soldiers on the fleet are ready to go, their faces full of fortitude and determination. They have been waiting for this moment to wear military uniforms and serve in the army all their lives.
Guard the border and serve the motherland, even if you die on the battlefield, you will have no regrets.
Distant battle information is continuously transmitted to the command cabin of the aircraft carrier's main ship, the highest commander of the aircraft carrier fleet. Pei Zhanyong was sitting in a conference room with a group of fleet executives.
Facing the next 100 situations that may occur, they must have 1,000 countermeasures. The country will not give up an inch of its border territory. This battle is not only a territorial issue, but also an issue of international status and deterrence.
Pei Zhanyong's face was stern, and the cigarette he held in his hand burned out long ash. He looked at the high-level subordinates at the scene and said with a solemn and majestic tone: "The next battle today will definitely be a tough battle. We in China have never fought such a fierce war with the enemy at sea.
If you go back to the last feudal dynasty, it was during the last feudal dynasty. At that time, our Chinese navy was completely defeated and I lost a reputation in the world. The group of foreigners who invaded us said that all Chinese soldiers were landlubbers and they could not fight naval battles at all.
What we are going to face today is Chouhao, the most powerful navy in the world. The Lyon aircraft carrier fleet ranks at least in the top five among all Chouhao aircraft carrier fleets. This is a naval team with extremely rich combat experience.
And our current fleet has just been established a few years ago, and this war has not yet started. The world's voices are already pessimistic about us, especially those Western powers, who are all waiting to see us be beaten into a pile of scrap metal and sink to the bottom of the sea.
To be honest, I personally do not have full confidence in this naval battle. Only by having the courage to admit my own shortcomings can I turn my disadvantages into advantages on the battlefield. I have only one request. Whenever the war starts, I will fight to death. Even if we are sunk and torn apart, we will still have to make the other side pay a heavy price.
If we win this battle, we will be China's eternal heroes. I just want to ask everyone here..."
"Do you have confidence!?" Pei Zhangyong's voice suddenly rose, his eyes were burning, and the expression on his face was even more impassioned.
Dong Dong——
Just as everyone was about to answer enthusiastically, there was a knock on the door of the conference room, and Pei Zhanyong's adjutant walked in.
